reads.title: How to Increase America's AI Lead Over China
reads.summary: A US think tank's detailed estimate of China's AI computing power, how much depends on US chips, and its policy proposals. Read it as one side's argument.

reads.title: The 2026 state of the climate report: challenges and opportunities
reads.summary: Scientists track 16 of Earth's "vital signs": seven are at record extremes, yet renewables passed coal in 2025. A clear, data-heavy look at where climate change stands.
